claim_ceiling: Exact counterexample to the assertion that a minimum-modulus critical point always has two contained straight root spokes. It is not a counterexample to Erdős #1041 or to curved inverse rays.

consequence.eliminated: Select a critical point of minimum critical-value modulus and join it to two roots by straight segments.
consequence.survives: The two descending inverse-ray branches at the same first merge, and selection of a later critical point or another curve.
